profit_taking._min_trigger_cost_mult_doc: P1 (2026-07-23 P&L diagnosis, 209 live closes): avg win $0.05 vs avg loss $0.19, measured cost overrun ~20.5bps - tier-1 was banking LESS than one round-trip cost unit. Floors tier-1's effective trigger (post vol-scaling/clamp) at mult x the entry's own estimated round-trip cost (Position.est_cost_bps, threaded from execution/pretrade.py's PreTradeDecision at fill time). 3.0x makes the first take bank >= 2 net cost-units after paying one. RAISE-only (never lowers an already-clear trigger); 0.0 est_cost_bps (legacy/restored positions) is exactly inert. Governs tier 1 only. config_guard enforces FATAL outside [1.0, 10.0].

stop_magnet._doc: v8 anti stop-hunt (Osler 2003/2005: stops cluster just past round numbers; sweep wicks overshoot the level then revert): a trailing-stop candidate within band_bps of the nearest round level on its sweep side is nudged to band_bps beyond it - always AWAY from price, ratchet-composed (never loosens a held stop), never blocks an exit. Break-even floor exempt (its contract is locking breakeven+buffer exactly). 0 = off (code default).

give_back._arm_doc: arm_gain_pct set from the honest ledger 2026-07-20 (n=55, movers n=13): MFE p50 0.30 / p75 0.45 / p90 0.72 - the old 1.5 arm sat ABOVE p90, so the ratchet armed once in 55 trades and movers round-tripped (median peak +0.64 -> median close -0.33). 0.6 sits inside the observed envelope (~2x median mover peak); giveback_frac 0.4 then locks 60 percent of peak. Category repair, not peak-fit: any arm in [0.5, 0.8] captures the same mass.
give_back._doc: peak-gain-armed exit floor: past arm_gain_pct lock 60% of the peak move; past tighten_gain_pct lock 75%. Reconstructed from the persisted high_water — restart-safe, ratchet-only.

signal_decay._doc: runner leash: when the entry signal is no longer confirmed in the position direction, chandelier trail distance shrinks by tighten_factor (exits only ever come SOONER)

inventory_coupling._doc: crowded book: fired tiers retire up to (1+max_boost)x the configured close_pct at full inventory pressure

conviction_runner._doc: entry-conviction (Position.confidence = meta p(win) at entry) scales the RUNNER leash: a LOW-conviction winner banks sooner (tighter chandelier trail), a HIGH-conviction winner keeps the full leash to run. One-sided by construction — only tightens, never loosens — so it composes with the ratchet and can only bring exits SOONER (invariant 5 safe). confidence >= neutral_conf, or <= 0 (unknown/restored/synthetic), keeps the FULL leash unchanged; between min_conf and neutral_conf the trail distance scales linearly down to min_trail_mult. This is how the desk lets a high-conviction winner run and cuts a marginal one short — the model's own p(win) decides.

time_stop._doc: P2 (2026-07-23 P&L diagnosis, PT-060): the no-progress cohort measured MFE 0.16% vs MAE -1.44% and recovered_after_stop 0/17 - trades showing no early favorable excursion overwhelmingly resolve to full-stop losses. A position that has NOT reached min_mfe_frac_of_tier1 of tier-1's EFFECTIVE trigger (the same vol-scaled/clamped/cost-floored number tier 1 fires on) within max_bars_no_progress bars is scratched full-close, converting a -1.4%-class loss into a ~-0.2%-class scratch. Reuses the persisted high_water (MFE) and the injected-now bars-in-trade clock (EX-8) - no parallel tracker, never reads wall clock. config_guard enforces FATAL max_bars_no_progress outside [6, 500] and min_mfe_frac_of_tier1 outside (0, 1] while enabled; WARN if max_bars_no_progress sits below tighten_after_bars (the time-stop then shadows that trail-decay window for exactly the no-progress trade class it targets - the shipped 36 vs 96 sits inside this band deliberately).
time_stop._max_bars_migration_doc: 36 -> 480 with the 432-bar horizon (2026-08-01). config_guard FATALs when ml.label_max_bars >= this value: a vertical at or beyond the no-progress scratch is unreachable - the exact clock inversion behind the 2026-07-31 era deadlock. 480 = 40h sits 48 bars past the 432 vertical, so the label always resolves BEFORE the scratch can preempt it. Guard ceiling 500. 480 also clears tighten_after_bars (96), so the shadowing WARN that applied at 36 no longer fires.

capital_management._stressor_regime_doc: 2026-08-11 OPERATOR-ADJUDICATED STRESSOR: capital reset 5000 -> 800 with a $100/month target (12.5%/mo). Deliberately aggressive - 'putting it through this stressor will see what we have right and what is completely wrong.' Money-denominated knobs rescaled by 0.16 where they denominate OUR capital (fat-finger cap, algo engagement); venue floors ($15 minimum tickets = Kraken physics) deliberately NOT scaled - at $800 they are 1.9% of equity per ticket and that bite is part of the stressor. Market-structure thresholds (pool/depth/ADV floors) describe the venue, not the wallet: unchanged. Goals escalate via the RP-072 ladder: each month closing at >=100% attainment raises the next month's effective goal x1.5, never down. The era-4 gate accrues from the reset instant (CAPITAL_EPOCH in scripts/cohort_eval.py) so the verdict population is one capital regime.
capital_management._pools_doc: THREE PROFIT POOLS on every realized win: savings_pct locked away untouchable; reserve_pct into the drawdown reserve (weekly rollover RP-070: a LOSING week refills its realized loss from reserve into trading cash before the working baseline can shrink - reserve only ever moves INTO cash, savings never moves); the rest stays as reinvestment and compounds sizing. Three-way parity guard: the pcts must sum to 100. Weekly ledger: outputs/weekly_ledger.csv, one signed row per ISO-week close.
capital_management._goals_doc: PROFIT GOALS (measurement only, no trading decision reads them): each period close grades realized PnL against its target and records hit/shortfall/loss + a structural miss reason (core/goals.py) into the audit (RP-070 week / RP-071 month) and outputs/{weekly,monthly}_ledger.csv; live progress-to-goal is surfaced in status.json for Grafana. 0 disables grading for that period (an untracked verdict). Current targets are the operator's $800 stressor regime (2026-08-10): $25/wk and $100/mo are ~3.1% weekly / ~12.5% monthly on the $800 book - expressly AGGRESSIVE by design, and the RP-072 ladder multiplies the monthly goal x1.5 after each met month. Retune freely, they change nothing but the grade.

risk._stop_round_doc: Osler round-number hygiene, WIDEN-BEYOND semantics since cut #7 (2026-08-11, operator-adjudicated bull-readiness package; risk/stop_placement.py documents the flip): a stop resting within buffer bps of a magnitude-relative round level (00/50 endings, half-step lattice) is moved offset bps BEYOND the level (long below, short above) - the herd's clustered stops fire first and ours only if the level actually breaks. The PREVIOUS semantics nudged to the near side (exit before the cascade), which meant any sweep TO the level ejected the position - the shakeout the directive names. Cost accepted knowingly: a genuine break exits into the cascade; the escalation ladder owns that. Widening bounded by buffer+offset bps; applied to BOTH the bracket sl leg (sl_frac back-derived so the traded bet stays the labeled bet) and the vol-scaled fallback. 0 disables. Also fixed with the flip: the old reader looked up config[risk_management], which does not exist - this knob was a phantom (never read) until cut #7.

manip_gate._doc: anti-scalp: manip_suspect_score (MAX of spoof / imbalance-whiplash / cross-venue book divergence, [0,1]) becomes a LIVE risk action on NEW entries — no effect on exits. Below downsize_at: unchanged. downsize_at..veto_at: shrink the entry linearly from 1.0x to min_scale. >= veto_at: veto the entry (SZ-045). Conservative defaults so only CLEAR painted-flow/venue-divergence bites; the spoofy liquidity label still hard-vetoes separately.

risk._mark_stale_sec_doc: a mark not refreshed (ticker OR book mid) within this many seconds is STALE: profit tiers, inventory derisk and the equity-peak/hard-stop use only a trusted (fresh + jump-confirmed) mark; the per-position protective stop (an escape) never defers. Generous vs the ~5s fast cycle so a healthy feed never trips it.

exit_escalation.description: Each unfilled exit attempt widens the slippage cap by widen_mult (capped at max_slippage_cap_pct); after market_after_attempts failed attempts the exit goes MARKET. Being out at a bad price beats being trapped at a good one. maker_first_profit_exits: a PROFIT-tier close rests post-only on our own side (sell at ask / buy at bid) on its FIRST attempt to capture the spread instead of paying it, then escalates into this marketable ladder if unfilled; risk exits are always marketable-first.

regime.description: Macro regime detection: Gaussian HMM (Hamilton) + TSMOM ensemble, hourly refit on daily candles

tiers._doc: v9 liquidity-tier isolation. An asset is classified into a cap-tier from its OWN trailing-median Kraken top-10 depth (a DERIVED category, never a hardcoded symbol map - overfit discipline), and the tier scales ONLY the two categorical executability floors (depth / spread). CORE reproduces the legacy flat floors (min_depth_usd 150000 / max_spread_bps 12) byte-identically, so ETH/BTC - and quant_trials / overfit - never move; MID/MICRO lower the floors so a low-volume asset (SUI/ARB/MINA/FLOW) is judged on its own scale and REACHES the honest edge/cost EV gate, which stays FLAT for every tier. Tier = the richest tier whose depth floor the median depth clears; a sub-floor asset falls to the thinnest tier. Bands are broad round numbers (category, not peak-fit); re-calibrate from observed per-asset depth once real recordings arm (Bucket C). enabled=false collapses every asset to CORE (exact legacy behavior). config_guard enforces monotonic floors and core==legacy.

liquidity_regime._spoof_healthy_book_threshold_doc: SD-003 (2026-07-31): the bar a spoof score must clear to veto a book that is ALREADY structurally healthy - depth >= min_depth_usd AND spread <= max_spread_bps, i.e. it passes the same test that would otherwise label it 'liquid'. A 'spoofy' label is a TOTAL veto (size_mult 0, reduce_only) applied feed-wide, and the bot's own SD-003 diagnostic measured it firing on 55% of classified cycles - the direct cause of the entry collapse (27-87 entries/day through 07-22 -> 0-11/day from 07-24) and therefore of the label starvation downstream. Live evidence at the fix: DOT scored spoof 0.61 on a 1.3bps spread (vetoed - wrong) while MINA 21.5bps/0.89 and FLOW 36.7bps/0.78 scored high on genuinely wide books (vetoed - right). 0.85 is chosen as the score a healthy book must reach to still be disbelieved: it sits above every observed tight-book false positive and below saturation (score = 1 - exp(-3*ewma), so 0.85 needs a sustained ~0.63 events/cycle EWMA vs 0.20 for the plain 0.45 bar) - a real layering attack that keeps pulling large near-touch levels still clears it. Whiplash is untouched and still vetoes independently. Set equal to spoof_score_threshold to restore the pre-fix behavior exactly.
liquidity_regime._decay_doc: v8 anti-layering (Stoikov 2018 near-touch information; spoof economics: far size is cheap to paint+cancel, touch size gets executed): order-book imbalance weights each level exp(-dist_bps/decay_bps) vs its side's own best, so painted far-from-touch walls decay out of the ratio. One source of truth - regime engine AND liquidity_model view imbalance read this key. 0 = legacy equal-weight.

ofi._doc: v9 SHADOW feature (TANK quant-2 K): event-based best-level order-flow imbalance per Cont-Kukanov-Stoikov 2014 (J. Financial Econometrics 12(1):47-88): e_n = 1{Pb_n>=Pb_n-1}qb_n - 1{Pb_n<=Pb_n-1}qb_n-1 - 1{Pa_n<=Pa_n-1}qa_n + 1{Pa_n>=Pa_n-1}qa_n-1 per external venue book, normalized by that venue's OWN EWMA best-level depth (unit consistency: OKX contract sizes never mix with spot coin sizes - the _combined_imbalance lesson) and by the REAL wall-clock poll gap dt (THALES A-3: per-event units alias with poll cadence), x60 = touch-depth turnover per MINUTE; per-venue rates averaged, then wall-time EWMA alpha=1-exp(-dt/ewma_tau_sec). Produces the view key ofi_event feeding ONLY the ml feature vector (ofi_dir; shadow-purity grep test in tests/test_ofi_feature.py, promotion criteria pre-registered in ml/features.py V9_NEUTRAL doc). Defaults derived, never fitted: ewma_tau_sec 60 = CKS's own sub-minute OFI impact horizon (~2 slow-cycle polls at the 30s cadence); depth_tau_sec 300 = one 5m bar, the stack's standard smoothing unit; stale_sec 120 mirrors watchdog stale_critical_sec / fair_value.kraken_stale_sec ('past this, treat as absent') - a gap beyond it RESETS the EWMA to the 0.0 neutral rather than decaying a fossil. config_guard: ewma_tau_sec FATAL outside [5, 600]; depth_tau_sec FATAL outside [30, 3600]; stale_sec FATAL outside [10, 900] and FATAL at/below the slow-cycle poll gap (the EWMA would reset every poll - a structurally dead feature).

fair_value._basis_mom_doc: v9 SHADOW feature (TANK quant-2 N): d(basis_bps)/dt over this window - per-SECOND slope of the samples inside the window, scaled x60 to bps/MINUTE (wall-time discipline, THALES A-3: never per-update units that alias with poll cadence). State (FVState.basis_hist -> basis_mom_bps) lives here where basis_bps already lives, rolled once per update - never hot-path recomputation. Feeds ONLY the ml feature vector (basis_mom_dir; shadow-purity grep test in tests/test_ofi_feature.py, promotion criteria pre-registered in ml/features.py V9_NEUTRAL doc). A stale Kraken touch (kraken_stale_sec above, W2-23) zeroes the momentum AND clears the window so a re-touch re-seeds instead of diffing against a fossil sample. Default 60s derived, never fitted: the perp-lead-lag horizon is sub-minute-to-minutes and 60s = 2-3 slow-cycle polls at the 30s cadence - the shortest window that holds >=2 samples with headroom; matches the OFI twin's ewma_tau_sec so the two shadow signals measure the same horizon. config_guard: FATAL outside [5, 600] and FATAL at/below the slow-cycle poll gap (one sample max = structurally zero forever).
