pretrade.description: Set maker/taker fees to your actual Kraken tier. 25/40 is the public spot floor - config_guard refuses live start below it unless allow_sub_floor_fees is true. price_exit_leg adds the unwind leg (taker fee + half spread) to the EV cost stack - entries must clear ROUND-TRIP cost, not entry-only.

tier_max_spread_bps._doc: v9 per-tier spread CEILING (the sole categorical veto that scales by cap-tier; keyed by the liquidity_regime tier carried on the pretrade context). core == max_spread_bps (15) exactly, so majors are unchanged; MID/MICRO widen the ceiling so the flat cap can't veto a low-volume asset BEFORE the honest edge/cost EV gate weighs its real spread. This is NOT a profitability concession: the EV gate (min_edge_cost_ratio, unchanged, flat) still requires edge to clear the wider round-trip cost, so an alt trades only when its edge genuinely covers its spread. A missing tier falls back to max_spread_bps. config_guard enforces core==max_spread_bps and micro>=mid>=core.

fee_recon._doc: W2-9 remainder: periodic REPORT-ONLY reconciliation of the account's ACTUAL Kraken fee tier (private TradeVolume, read-only) against BOTH configured bps sources - the maker_fee_bps/taker_fee_bps above (what OrderManager books fees at) AND pretrade.maker_fee_bps/taker_fee_bps (the pretrade EV gate's cost stack, threaded into OrderManager via main.py's pretrade_fee_bps constructor arg) - timed off hourly_cycle's injected now (never wall-clock). Never mutates config.json at runtime - a mismatch on EITHER source only WARNs + emits OM-080 once per interval, so the operator re-tunes the diverging bps consciously (lifted-threshold discipline). Flags when configured < actual (a gate is underestimating cost - the dangerous direction) regardless of tolerance, or when |configured - actual| exceeds tolerance_bps in either direction. tolerance_bps=1.0: the smallest Kraken tier step matters at our ~20.5bps measured cost overrun (P1, 2026-07-23 P&L diagnosis, 209 live closes) - looser and a real tier change could hide inside the noise band. interval_hours=24: daily is frequent enough to catch a volume-tier change within a trading day without hammering the private endpoint. Fails silent (debug-level skip, never raises) on missing/invalid credentials, DRY_RUN without keys, network errors, or a malformed TradeVolume response. config_guard enforces tolerance_bps in (0, 50] FATAL, interval_hours in [1, 168] FATAL.

sim_fill._doc: DRY-RUN passive-fill realism (MP-7). queue_aware gates a resting limit's fill on the depth resting AHEAD of it at its price clearing first (Huang-Lehalle-Rosenbaum queue-reactive / Moallemi-Yuan queue value: state-independent Poisson fills over-credit passive execution and bias candidate labels). Eligible once that depth ratchets down (max of observed shrink and a vol-scaled geometric turnover) to within queue_tol_frac of our own order size; the passive_base_prob*exp(-dist/sigma) draw then applies to the front-of-queue remainder. CONSCIOUSLY ENABLED (2026-07-21, execution-truth harness): the old flat-Poisson model over-credited passive fills ~95% at the touch with no queue/trade-through/adverse-selection, inflating the dry-run track record; queue-gating makes the paper fill honest. It changes the DRY-RUN label distribution, so it was enabled with a conscious re-baseline: pytest (1353) + smoke (219) + assurance (47) re-verified green (two controlled smoke fixtures — persistence + lifecycle plumbing — pinned to the deterministic fill model since their subject is persistence/pipeline, not fill realism; realism is tested in tests/test_sim_fill_queue). quant_trials is unaffected (it does not use the sim fill). The overfit live-data gap/pbo/dof fails are pre-existing and independent of the fill model (they read the fixed history CSV, not fills) — a data-thinness signal, not a regression. CAVEAT: honest fills are rarer, so verify passive fills are not starved at your live sigma/poll-cadence (scripts/calibrate_fills.py) before trusting the labels. Constants lifted from the fill path (overfit discipline). Live path unaffected: the venue owns real queueing.
sim_fill._calibration_life_sec_doc: The order life the passive hazard was CALIBRATED at (XV-021: n_bar=5.0 polls x 5s, outputs/fill_calibration.json). 2026-08-08 owed-40 fix: _passive_poll_prob normalizes each order's per-poll hazard by calibration_life_sec/ttl so per-ORDER fill probability matches calibration at ANY ttl - previously the 6h long-book life compounded 0.048/poll into a guaranteed fill at the resting offset (-50bps signature, 22/41 entries; positive BTC/ETH markout). EXECUTION-ERA BOUNDARY #3: corpus rows before this commit were filled under the compounding simulator; treat cohorts across this date like the XV-021 ts~1785717000 boundary. Exponent clamps at 1.0 (shorter-than-calibrated orders keep the measured hazard). Recalibrate with per-TTL buckets when calibrate_fills gains long-life recordings (XV-023).
sim_fill._passive_base_prob_doc: 0.45 -> 0.048 on 2026-08-02 (operator directive: the sim must trade as if real rent-money is on the line - no flattering fills). MEASURED, not chosen: scripts/calibrate_fills.py XV-021 inverted the market's own trade-through rate from 22,854 hypothetical resting-limit trials across 2.4 GB of recorded book frames - near-touch band sf_base 0.048, Wilson [0.046, 0.050]. The prior 0.45 credited passive fills ~9x more often than the recorded market crossed them, which is the fill-side twin of the fee-side finding (25.1% of winning touches already die to costs). CAVEATS, both live: XV-022 - the exp(-d_bar) form is misspecified (identifiable buckets invert to 0.048/0.060/0.082, rising with distance), so 0.048 is the conservative end of a [0.048, 0.082] band, and the FORM deserves replacement eventually, not just the constant; and this changes the dry-run label distribution mid-432-cohort - the first 11 post-migration closes were earned under flattered fills, so the cohort's eventual verdict must be read knowing ts 1785717000-ish is an execution-regime boundary. EXPECTED CONSEQUENCE, stated so nobody reads it as a regression: paper entry rate will drop sharply - that is the honest fill rate, and starving is the truthful outcome the 2026-07-21 queue_aware _doc warned to check for. Re-run calibrate_fills.py as recordings accumulate.
sim_fill._passive_hazard_with_book_doc: OWED 57 / EXECUTION-ERA BOUNDARY #4 (commit aeeaae36, 2026-08-10T11:03:35Z - cut cohorts on this UTC instant, not on a local date). false = the observed book is ground truth. The passive hazard and _sim_maker_cross were two models of ONE physical event: calibrate_fills.py measures f = how often the market actually crossed a hypothetical resting limit within its life (recorded book frames), core.fill_calibration.invert_base_prob solves passive_base_prob so the HAZARD ALONE reproduces f over n_bar polls, and _poll_dry then ALSO filled deterministically whenever the live book crossed - the very event f counts. The hazard only ever ran INSIDE `if book:`, so it modelled nothing the snapshot could not already show; it was purely additive. Combined per-order rate was 1-(1-f)^2 = 2f-f^2 = 22.0% against an 11.66% target - 1.88x at the touch and approaching 2x as f falls, weighted toward the worst end because 57.2% of post_only fills rest within 5bps and 38.4% of all 401 positions were opened by a near-touch post_only leg. EXPECTED CONSEQUENCE, stated so nobody reads it as a regression: the paper fill rate roughly HALVES near the touch. That is the honest rate, and starving is the truthful outcome - the same warning the 2026-07-21 queue_aware _doc and the 2026-08-02 passive_base_prob change both carried. Setting true restores the pre-boundary simulator EXACTLY, for reproducing a pre-#4 cohort; it is NOT a tuning knob and must never be set true to recover entry volume. Corpus rows before this commit were filled under the double-counting simulator - treat cohorts across this date like the #3 (owed 40 TTL) and XV-021 ts~1785717000 boundaries.

hedging._churn_doc: 2026-08-07 ADA churn (-$318/25min, 147 laps): a COLD EWMA reads |rho|~1 or 0.0, both artifacts, and the open/unwind pair flapped on them every 10s. corr_min_samples gates OPENS on evidence (12 update ticks - reachable well inside the 0.5h median uptime; unwinds are NEVER gated, invariant 5). rehedge_cooldown_sec blocks re-opening an unwound asset. churn_max_unwinds/{window} latches the asset (FW-070, opens only) and AUTO-releases warm+window - release never depends on the gated action (deadlock discipline, see the HANDOFF doc).

markout._doc: post-fill mark-out: the empirical adverse-selection meter (execution/markout.py). For each NEW-risk fill, at each horizon the signed post-fill move vs the trusted mark is markout_bps = side_sign*(mark-fill)/fill*1e4. NEGATIVE = the price moved against us right after we filled = we were scalped (the ground truth the risk.manip_gate pre-empts). Measurement only - takes no trading decision. window = rolling obs per asset+horizon; grace_sec = extra time to find a fresh mark before dropping an unmeasured fill.

leverage.description: use_margin=false keeps everything spot (1x). Region cap: Kraken allows max 10x here; pair-level caps may be lower.

position_sizer._max_position_doc: THE cap that actually bounds a live entry (risk/position_sizer.py reads this copy; capital_management's identically-named key feeds only CapitalManager.calculate_position_size, which has no callers). Raised 10 -> 25 in 6e57ebd7 so fractional Kelly's own edge-scaling can express instead of being strangled, then silently DELETED by an unrelated p_bar_mode commit (ae4b5314) - the entry cap reverted to PositionSizer's 10.0 code default for weeks while config_guard's parity FATAL read clean, because it resolved this key with the capital_management copy as its default (an absent key can never differ from itself). Restored to the operator's 25 and the guard now uses a None sentinel, so a missing key FATALs instead of reading as parity.
position_sizer._p_bar_doc: 2026-07-27 drought diagnosis (operator-directed fix): the entry p(win) bar was an absolute literal sitting BELOW the net-Kelly breakeven (0.632 at current tiers/stop/fees) - a phantom the config guard had flagged (entries in [0.55, breakeven) passed the bar only to die SZ-030 one step later), and any tier/fee change silently re-breaks an absolute number. mode 'derived' pins the bar to the geometry: max(1/(1+b_net) + p_bar_edge_margin, min_p_win); min_p_win's remaining role is the FLOOR. edge_margin ships 0.0 = pure de-phantomization, no new fitted number - raising it is a gate-tightening decision that must clear the overfit discipline (quant trials, never tuned to a backtest peak). INTERLOCK: ml.exploration.p_win (0.64, the synthetic probe p) must clear the derived bar or the F0b probe trickle dies at SZ-023 - config_guard WARNs when clearance drops below 0.005. mode 'absolute' reverts to the historical literal bar.
position_sizer._vol_doc: vol scaling of the ticket (lifted from buried literals, identical defaults): scalar = clamp(vol_target_ann_pct / max(sigma_annual_pct, vol_sigma_floor_pct), vol_scalar_min, vol_scalar_max). tier_reach_decay: each next profit tier assumed reach_decay x as likely as the previous when deriving the payoff ratio b/b_net (feeds the Kelly breakeven).

inventory_aggression._doc: lean in when the book is light, back off as short-term entry clustering or long-term gross heat builds; linear light_boost->heavy_cut over max(u_long, u_short)

inventory_skew._doc: Avellaneda-Stoikov reservation skew, taker transplant (A-S 2008 r = s - q.gamma.sigma^2; Table 1: ~6% expected-profit cost for >2x lower P&L variance). SIGNED and direction-aware, unlike inventory_aggression (gross/unsigned): only entries that INCREASE net exposure are scaled, mult = max(floor_mult, 1 - gamma.(q.d).(sigma/sigma_ref_pct)^2-amp with amp clamped to [amp_min, amp_max]; inventory-reducing entries are never penalized. mode: off | shadow (log the would-be multiplier, apply nothing) | active. Shadow by default: flip to active only after the shadow ledger shows sensible multipliers on real entries.

conviction._doc: Compounder Phase A conviction formula (risk/conviction.py, spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-24-compounder-framework-design.md §2): deterministic admission for CONVICTION (non-probe) entries — all terms must agree, no fitted weights, every disposition a registered CV-* code. mode=report (shipped default) logs dispositions with BYTE-IDENTICAL entry behavior — the threshold-derivation period. mode=enforce skips denied conviction entries; the flip is a conscious operator decision after report telemetry review + green quant-trials at 200x1200 (never widen, never tune to a backtest peak).
conviction._agreement_floor_doc: gate-stack agreement = pass-fraction of gates_passed (the same arithmetic strategies/signal_gates.py:225 uses for its confidence). 0.75 = at least 3/4 of the evaluated stack agrees. Derivation: report-period starting default; re-derive from the reported agreement distribution before any enforce flip.
conviction._ev_cost_mult_doc: conviction entries must clear ev_cost_mult x the pretrade gate's MEASURED round-trip cost stack (est_cost_bps: fees + spread + impact + exit leg). 2.0 = twice full cost, vs pretrade.min_edge_cost_ratio 1.3 for ANY entry; config_guard FATALs below that bar (a conviction bar under the pretrade bar is vacuous).
conviction._cadence_doc: governor mirror of ml.exploration.probe_share_window (40): rolling admit-share of the last share_window conviction EVALUATIONS, global + per-regime. Outside [share_lo, share_hi] with >= share_min_n samples -> CV-050/051 on the state TRANSITION only. It alarms, it never auto-tunes. share_min_n suppresses judgment on thin windows, so a restart-reset window is silent, never false-alarming.

context._doc: Compounder Phase B context engine (data/context_engine.py, spec §3; evidence doc 2026-07-24 both passes). TELEMETRY-ONLY this phase: no decision path reads it until Phase C wires the long book. Slow structure = gates/context, never 5m model features (evidence doc §0). Every source degrades to unknown - a state, not a guess.
context._next_halving_doc: block-clock ESTIMATE; refresh as the epoch approaches. Past halvings are code constants (chain history).
context._phase_doc: labeled CONVENTIONS over n=3 halvings - descriptive, no statistical claim (evidence doc pass 1 §1); consumers may only tighten on late phases, never boost.
context._stress_doc: fixed-clip z conventions (equity_risk_z pattern, no fitted weights); STRONG-graded as a risk dial only, never alpha (evidence doc pass 1 §3). 10y-2y is the first term to drop if budget tightens.
context._flow_doc: COT leveraged-funds net delta is a CROWDING dial read jointly with basis_bps - post-ETF net-short is carry, not direction (pass 2 §1.3c, BINDING); stablecoin weekly supply delta per Ante et al. FRL 2021. Never signed direction.
context._event_doc: cadence-pause windows only - direction evidence is contradictory (pass 1 §4); consumed by the long book in Phase C, nothing in Phase B.

long_book._doc: Compounder Phase C long-horizon accumulation book (risk/long_book.py, spec §4-5). PAPER-FIRST: rung 0 binds until realized book-tagged track record earns rung 1+. Engines are parameterized instances of the existing tier/sizer machinery - never duplicates. All thresholds below are planning conventions pending paper re-derivation.
long_book._assets_doc: majors only at start - thin alts are the pump-and-dump surface (evidence doc pass 2 §1.1d); extend consciously.
long_book._entry_doc: post_only maker bid add_offset_pct below mark, one growing position per asset (averaging adds), spacing throttles cadence; TH-013 zone hygiene (LongBookEngine.shift_off_magnets, task C3) shifts bids AWAY from magnets by zone_buffer_pct whenever within zone_tol_pct (LB-020); zone_buffer_pct > zone_tol_pct by design so a shifted bid clears its own tolerance band around the same magnet. add_offset_pct lowered 1.5->0.5 (task C4 discovery): the shared risk_firewall.entry_collar_bps (100bps) rejects ANY entry deviating from ref by more than that - post_only carries no exemption (execution/risk_firewall.py's price collar runs before purpose is even consulted) - so the shipped 1.5% (150bps) offset made every long-book add unconditionally FW-050 collar-rejected; 0.5% + the worst-case TH-013 zone-shift margin stays under the collar (core/config_guard.py's new coherence FATAL pins this).
long_book._ttl_doc: C4 review fix (Critical #1): order_ttl_hours is this book's OWN resting-order lifetime override (execution/order_manager.py's per-order ttl_sec), NOT the shared 5m order_manager.order_timeout_sec (25s) - a patient maker bid needs to live for HOURS to have any real chance of a paper/live fill, not 25 seconds. Each _long_book_cycle pass cancels-and-replaces a resting bid once its price has drifted past (add_offset_pct + zone_buffer_pct) from the current mark, so the long TTL never means a stale, unfillable price sits for the full 6h. retry_backoff_minutes (Important #3): once decide_add yields a plan but sizing/submission then fails (sizer veto, sub-ordermin, firewall reject, zero notional), the asset backs off for this long before the NEXT attempt - without it, the exact same failure would re-fire (and re-audit) every ~30s slow_cycle tick.
long_book._thesis_doc: structural invalidation full-close (LB-031), NOT a volatility stop; wide by design - the tier/give-back machinery handles profit protection.
long_book._context_doc: term-4 alignment: adds need context known + stress dial <= stress_max_for_add; event windows pause adds (LB-050); contraction phase doubles spacing (down-only cadence, never direction; phase buckets are labeled conventions). pause_in_crisis (task C5, C4-review item 4): self.macro.state(asset).label=="crisis" pauses adds via the SAME LB-050 deny path as event windows - down-only cadence, exits never touched.
long_book._ladder_doc: evidence buys size (spec §5): rung 0 = paper only; r1-r3 ceilings as equity fractions unlocked by realized BOOK-TAGGED closes; breach dd_downgrade_pct, measured as the drop from the book's own equity-curve peak normalized by TOTAL PORTFOLIO EQUITY (not the book's own peak) -> INSTANT one-rung drop (LB-041; de-risk fast, re-earn slowly). Live arming remains the global config+restart+ARM LIVE road regardless of rung. adverse_min_hours (task C5 item 3(b)): a risk-off context episode (stress > stress_max_for_add) must SUSTAIN for at least this long, held-exposure-throughout and drawdown-under-the-downgrade-line-throughout, to count as a survived adverse transition (r3's own gate) - LB-042 on survival.

position_sizer._doc: main.py builds a SECOND PositionSizer for this book from long_book.position_sizer. The block was absent, so every knob ran at risk/position_sizer.py's code defaults and the long book's entry cap has ALWAYS been the 10.0 fallback - invisible to the capital_management/position_sizer parity FATAL, which never covered this copy. Lifted at the IDENTICAL default (behavior-preserving, CLAUDE.md overfit discipline) so the number is now stated, guarded (config_guard._long_book_checks) and tunable. Deliberately NOT the 5m book's 25: this is the value that has actually been running, not an invented one. Every other sizer knob still resolves to the code default by design - the EvidenceLadder ceiling, not Kelly, is what bounds this book.

long_book._profit_doc: long-horizon tier geometry (wider, absolute pct - vol_scaled off); euphoria phase tightens give-back to euphoria_giveback_frac (down-only per the disposition-effect inversion, evidence pass 2 §1.1a); PT-060 time-stop OFF by design (patience IS the strategy).

sampling._doc: State-Change Sampler: register candidates on state-change EVENTS instead of every confirmed-signal cycle. Symmetric CUSUM on log returns (Page 1954 Biometrika 41:100-115; Lopez de Prado AFML 2018 ch.2 vol-scaled symmetric CUSUM filter; Easley/Lopez de Prado/O'Hara 2012 JPM 39:19-29 information-driven clocks), h = cusum_k * sigma_bar, OR-fused with the bot's own macro/liquidity regime-label flips (a label flip is a new state even with zero net drift). Clock sampling gave mean per-asset label uniqueness 0.06 (2016 rows ~ 120 independent lessons). Calibration on 60h real Kraken 5m data (ETH/BTC/SOL/XRP): k=3.0 -> ~30 events/day/asset, median gap ~45min, implied uniqueness ~0.11 at one-third the row rate; effective-lessons/day is FLAT across k in [1,4] (8h label span bounds it), so 3.0 is a plateau choice, not a fitted peak. Win = state diversity + 3-6x less redundancy, not more raw information.
sampling._bounds: guard: 1.0 <= cusum_k <= 6.0 when enabled (below 1 sigma is clock sampling by another name; above 6 starves the corpus)

ml._label_max_bars_migration_doc: 24 -> 432 on 2026-08-01 (operator decision: 1.5-day swing). 432 x 5m = 36h. Measured two independent ways. (1) GEOMETRY: the cost floor pins PT at 2.058%, which at 24 bars is 4.07 horizon-sigma; peer-reviewed work reporting usable triple-barrier balance sits at ~0.8-1.0 (arXiv 2504.02249 tunes 29d/9% explicitly FOR balance; Financial Innovation 11(1) 2025 reports 36/35/29 on crypto). At 432 the SAME barriers land at ~0.96 sigma - barriers need no change, only the horizon. (2) SELECTOR SKILL: this bot's horizon_shadow recorder (23,826 rows) shows break-even selection rate rising monotonically - top 20% needed at 6 bars, 40% at 24, 51% at 48, 56% at 96. A longer horizon does not create alpha; it collapses the skill required to harvest it. Corroborated by the deployed calibrator, which maps its whole input range to a ceiling of 0.2164 against a p_bar of 0.63 - structurally unreachable at the old geometry, which is why gate_efficacy_report measured -12.2% adverse separation. COST: live-label throughput falls ~18x; the offset is candidate admission to the evidence gate, tracked separately.
ml._label_max_bars_doc: THE LABEL HORIZON, in 5m bars, and (main.py deadline_ts) the live bracket deadline - one number, so the label's vertical and the traded position's deadline can never diverge. 96 -> 24 on 2026-07-31 (era-deadlock fix, docs/quant/2026-07-31_live_label_era_deadlock.md, option E of the advocate/skeptic/controller debate). DERIVATION, not a tuned value: the exit ladder's PT-060 no-progress scratch fires at profit_taking.time_stop.max_bars_no_progress = 36 bars, so a 96-bar vertical was UNREACHABLE - it sat 60 bars beyond the point the ladder scratches. Measured consequence: only 9.3% of live positions ever reached bar 96, so essentially no live row could carry a tb_* barrier, every live label fell into an old label era, era exclusion dropped all 251 of them, live_clean was 0, and the evidence gate was pinned to ['logistic'] permanently. At 24 bars the vertical sits INSIDE the scratch (24 < 36) and the measured live survival curve says 40.5% of positions reach it (vs 9.3% at 96) - a 4.4x increase in era-valid live labels - while leaving the cost-floored barriers (label_pt_cost_mult x label_round_trip_cost_pct) untouched, so a 'win' still has to clear the cost stack. config_guard FATALs a vertical at or beyond the no-progress scratch: that ordering IS the bug this fixes.
ml._label_mode_doc: triple_barrier = label candidates/bootstrap by the market/horizon-only symmetric pt/sl barrier (label_pt_vol_mult/label_sl_vol_mult below) so the label measures SIGNAL QUALITY - operator decision, 2026-07-26, task-signalquality-brief.md, consciously overriding c36aa90's exit_policy default: replaying the live exit engine made the label encode WHICH EXIT FIRED (a risk-control choice, e.g. the P2 time-stop) rather than whether the signal was good, measured as a 100x label-rate spread across exit reasons and barrier-alone AUC beating the trained model's own AUC. 'exit_policy' remains a valid value (the rollback path / A-B arm): it labels by replaying the live exit engine (hard stop max(stop_loss_pct, stop_vol_mult*sigma) + tiered scale-outs + give-back/trailing) so the model trains on the SAME bet it is traded on. Unsupported values FATAL in config_guard. See docs/quant/2026-07-26_label_signal_quality.md.
ml._label_pt_cost_mult_doc: Cost-floored barrier geometry (spec D2, docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-27-geometry-alignment-design.md, geometry-alignment task 2): floors the SIGMA INPUT to ml/labeling.py's barrier_geometry() so the profit distance never falls below pt_cost_mult round-trip costs - sigma_eff = max(sigma_bar, pt_cost_mult * (label_round_trip_cost_pct/100) / label_pt_vol_mult), flooring the INPUT (never the distances) keeps the 8:6 pt:sl ratio exact by construction, one knob, no per-barrier distortion. At the shipped cost 0.5%: floor puts pt at 2%, sl at 1.5% (4.0 * 0.5% = 2% profit distance -> costs are 25% of the gross win). 0 disables the floor (legacy bare 8sigma/6sigma). Consumed by BOTH the candidate labeler (this key) and the live bracket-exit engine (Task 5) via the same pure helper - one bet, labeled and traded identically. Guarded in core/config_guard.py: FATAL outside [0, 20], WARN in (0, 2) (costs above 50% of the profit distance).
ml._label_bars_stale_cycles_doc: FW-081 (staleness audit 2026-08-16): slow-cycles of labeler bars-cache silence on an ACTIVE (symbol_map) asset before main._label_bars_age_check emits its latched once-per-episode WARNING. Threshold seconds = this x polling_interval_sec x slow_cycle_every_n (shipped: 240 x 5s x 6 = 7200s = 2h = 24 missed 5m bars). Detection only - no order, size, or exit decision reads it. Exists because FW-080 goes blind when the fetch path dies outright (no _kr_candles entry -> the merge loop skips the asset before the check runs), which is exactly how a dead feed would present. Rotated-out assets are not checked: their frozen caches are expected (DOT sat 157h stale after legitimate skimmer rotation). Guard: FATAL if the derived threshold is <= 1200s (4 empty 5m bars are legitimate on thin Kraken pairs - the FW-080 floor, latency audit 2026-08-07).

multi_horizon._doc: SHADOW-ONLY: score each candidate at several holding horizons and log the outcome to shadow_path (never the live label/model). Evidence for whether some asset pairs pay over a longer hold than others - promote a horizon feature only once scripts/horizon_report.py shows a per-asset edge. All horizons must be <= label_max_bars.
multi_horizon._horizons_bars_doc: Re-scaled 2026-07-31 with the label vertical (96 -> 24 bars, era-deadlock fix): the guard requires every shadow horizon <= label_max_bars, since a horizon beyond the vertical can never be labeled. Same shape as before - a short, a mid, and the vertical itself - now spanning 30min/1h/2h instead of 2h/4h/8h. Shadow-only: these never touch the live label or model.
multi_horizon._horizons_bars_migration_doc: Re-scaled 2026-08-01 with the vertical 24 -> 432: [6,12,24] -> [108,216,432] (9h/18h/36h). Same quarter/half/vertical shape, so the guard's 'every horizon <= label_max_bars' holds by construction. Keeping the short rungs matters: the shadow recorder is what MEASURED the break-even selection curve that justifies this migration, and losing them would remove the ability to re-measure it.

exploration._doc: DRY-RUN active learning: take a fraction of confirmed signals as small paper trades so real-fill labels accrue and the cold model can improve. Hard-gated on dry_run; auto-off once until_live_rows history rows exist. SCALE NOTE: on ledgers under ~$5k set size_scale=1.0 - a 0.25 slice of a small kelly ticket falls below min_ticket_usd and every exploration entry gets vetoed (observed at $25k/scale-0.25).
exploration._until_live_rows_doc: = corpus_target_live / floor_frac (300 / 0.25) - the hard-off begins exactly where the decay's trickle floor ends; probes decay 1.0->0.25 over live 300->1200 instead of cliffing at 500 (P3 review fix: 500 hard-offed exploration before the corpus decay could ever reach its floor_frac floor, so production decay only ever ranged [1.0, 0.6] and the derivation's promised trickle never existed). config_guard WARNs if until_live_rows < corpus_target_live/floor_frac.
exploration._unwind_doc: learning-phase anti-wedge: when the book is at max_concurrent_positions and NO open position carries a pending label vector (schema gates dropped them), the row pipeline is starved - unwind the oldest such position (one per slow cycle, dry-run only, min age gate) so slots go back to trades that teach. ML-071.
exploration._drought_doc: SIGNAL-DROUGHT extension of the VOI fastpath: with a free slot the fastpath normally stays dormant (a new teach trade can open regardless, holding is free). When NO entry has been admitted for realize_drought_h hours (thin weekend books, sustained gate vetoes) that premise fails - holding buys nothing and costs label latency - so the fastpath arms with free slots too. Clock resets on any successful entry-order submit. 0 disables the extension.
exploration._fastpath_doc: VALUE-OF-INFORMATION fast-forward: the realize horizon only throttles learning when the book is FULL (a free slot admits a new teach trade regardless). Full book -> the stalest position realizes at fastpath spans (0.25 = ~2h, the guard floor) to buy a teach slot with the least label-richness cost; free slots -> the full realize_after_label_spans window (holding is free, outcome richer). Faster live-label flow reaches the evidence gate's floors sooner, unlocking model capacity earlier - compounding, not sloppy: candidate label geometry (label_max_bars) is untouched, live rows carry barrier='realized', and the uniqueness/recency weighting applies as usual. 0 disables the fastpath.
exploration._realize_doc: learning-phase LABEL REALIZATION (ML-073, dry-run only, auto-off at until_live_rows). Fixes the SD-002 starvation loop: exploration paper trades must CLOSE to become live labels, but in a quiet book they hit no tier/stop and sit for days, filling the book to capacity so no new teaching entry can fire (observed: 0 entries, model cold at 35 live rows, retrain requested 18x with no new data to clear it). A position held past the model's LABEL HORIZON (realize_after_label_spans * ml.label_max_bars * bar-seconds; default 1x = ~8h) has already resolved its triple-barrier outcome, so its realized close IS the label the model expects - close the stalest such position (one per cycle) to bank the live label and free a teach slot. NOT a free literal: the horizon is the labeler's own window. Set realize_mature_labels=false to disable.
exploration._p_win_doc: synthetic probe prior, PLACEHOLDER not measurement: its contract (config_guard) is to clear the derived net-Kelly breakeven with >=0.005 headroom so the F0b trickle survives. Re-derived 2026-07-29: the payoff-ratio unit fix (tier closes compound in original-position space, %-of-CURRENT contract) moved the honest config-average breakeven 0.632 -> 0.690, so the old 0.64 (set against the flat-weighted 0.632) fell below it and would have SZ-030-vetoed every probe on the non-bracket arm. 0.70 restores the designed clearance; probe notional is floor-dominated (label-acquisition floor + min ticket), so this does not inflate probe size.

aggressive._doc: conviction-scaled aggressive exploration (dry-run only). Normal exploration always min-sizes, so the model only sees fill outcomes on timid marginal trades. With probability frac, when the model conviction (real model_p) >= min_conviction AND manip_suspect <= max_manip AND the regime is not crisis, take a FULL-conviction ticket (size on sizing_p, no size shrink, no min-ticket floor) so the model learns from confident calls at real size. Still bounded by every risk-stack veto (CVaR/heat/budget/inventory/leverage), the manip gate, and kelly_cap. Labels stay honest (real fill + real outcome).

exploration._drought_floor_doc: F0b livelock repair (grill C2 CONFIRMED, operator decision docs/quant/2026-07-25_livelock_f0_decision.md): the share cap's window advances only on admissions, so zero flow freezes it closed forever (SZ-047xSZ-030 deadlock, 2026-07-24/25 drought). When the share cap is the BINDING denial and the ML-073 drought clock (engine-time _last_entry_admit_ts, admissions of ANY kind) shows >= drought_hours of zero admissions, one probe is admitted per min_spacing_hours, tagged SZ-048, recorded into the window. The PLACED-probe cadence is stronger than the admission cadence: a successful submit resets the drought clock (submit sites), so successful floor probes are >= drought_hours apart - min_spacing_hours only paces retries while submits keep getting vetoed. Derivation: drought_hours = the 8h label horizon; min_spacing_hours = horizon/4 -> at most 4 floor probes per horizon. Outside droughts the branch is unreachable - behavior byte-identical to P3. config_guard: drought_hours FATAL < 1.0; min_spacing_hours FATAL < 0.5; FATAL if min_spacing_hours < drought_hours/8 (rate would exceed the K-per-horizon bound).

admission._flip_doc: FLIPPED to 'budget' 2026-07-31 by explicit operator order ('flip it') after the dark landing deployed battery-verified on the PC (33498d2). Rollback = set 'share_cap' + restart (warm legacy window, one key).
admission._mode_doc: SPB-R probe-admission redesign (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-30-probe-budget-spbr-design.md), ESCAPE HATCH + merge default. 'share_cap' = the shipped SZ-047 rolling-share-cap deque path, byte-identical INCLUDING _explore_rng draw counts (test-pinned in tests/test_probe_budget.py); 'budget' = the scarcity-priced token budget below. The flip is a conscious operator config change via the git remote-control plane + restart, never a runtime toggle. Rollback = one key + restart, resuming a WARM deque (the legacy window is fed in BOTH modes).

budget._tokens_per_day_migration_doc: 15 -> 5 with the 432-bar horizon (2026-08-01). NOT bookkeeping - the battery caught this. The book converts at most max_concurrent_positions x 24/burst_hours = 5 x 24/24 = 5 probes/day at a 36h hold (the true rate is 5 x 24/36 = 3.3/day; the guard uses burst_hours and so understates it). Issuing 15/day against that ceiling banks tokens that can never be spent - the same shape as the SZ-047 share cap whose frozen window deadlocked exploration for a week. 5 matches the ceiling the guard computes. Throughput is unchanged in practice because the BOOK, not the budget, is the binding constraint at this horizon.
budget._tokens_per_day_doc: THE primary knob. Derived from existing config structure, not measured performance: book label throughput ceiling = capital_management.max_concurrent_positions (5) x 24h / 8h label horizon (ml.label_max_bars 96 x 5m bars). Budget above this buys tokens the book cannot convert (config_guard WARNs above the ceiling, and below 24/drought_floor.drought_hours where the SZ-048 backstop would out-rate the budget). Honest name: tokens, not labels - realized labels/day ~= tokens_per_day / avg_cost.
budget._burst_hours_migration_doc: 2.0 -> 24.0 with the 432-bar horizon (2026-08-01). This knob mirrors the labeler's horizon, now 36h - but config_guard FATALs burst_hours outside [1, 24], so 36 is not expressible. 24.0 is the maximum admissible value. The guard WILL WARN that 24.0 != 36.0h; that divergence is INTENTIONAL and forced by the bound. Raising the bound widens the burst a probe budget may bank - a risk decision, deliberately not bundled here.
budget._burst_hours_doc: capacity window = the labeler's own horizon. Followed label_max_bars 96 -> 24 on 2026-07-31 (era-deadlock fix), so 8h -> 2h: C = tokens_per_day x burst_hours/24 = 15 x 2/24 = 1.25 tokens. Throughput is UNCHANGED (refill is still 15/day); only the burst you may bank shrinks with the horizon, which is the invariant this knob encodes. Note the shorter horizon also RAISES the book conversion ceiling (max_concurrent_positions 5 x 24/2 = 60/day vs 15/day at the 8h horizon), so tokens_per_day 15 is now well inside it rather than exactly at it - raising throughput is a separate, evidence-gated decision and was deliberately NOT bundled with the deadlock fix. config_guard WARNs when it diverges from the labeler's horizon.
budget._scarcity_pricing_doc: false = flat cost 1.0 - the 1-knob rule, kept as a REAL config point so the simplicity ladder can be run against pricing honestly (OF-4 discipline). true: cost(a,r) = clip(1/S, 1, C) with S = max(w_asset, w_regime), w = clip(sqrt(target/(1+n_live)), floor, 1) - sqrt is the Bernoulli-SE/Wilson-width scale (n^-1/2); scarce (asset, regime) labels are cheap, redundant ones expensive; EITHER scarcity dimension redeems (max), and an unmapped regime label prices fail-safe scarce at 1.0. Admission is PROBABILISTIC: p = clip(tokens/cost, 0, 1) on a DEDICATED seeded rng - relative admission rates are 1/cost (price = inverse admission weight), every arm's p > 0 whenever tokens > 0: no starvation wall by construction.
budget._scarcity_floor_doc: null = reuse ml.exploration.corpus_decay.floor_frac (0.25): ONE trickle-floor concept in the whole file, not two.
budget._refund_doc: deduct at PLACEMENT (the decision only stashes; a probe vetoed between decision and placement - manip $15-withhold, min-ticket, SZ-046, firewall - costs ZERO), refund on an UNFILLED entry terminal (fill_ratio == 0, SZ-052). The budget then depletes only on probes that actually FILL - i.e. on labels. Leak-proof by construction: the cost rides in order.meta and OrderManager terminates every entry within order_timeout_sec (+ <= 1 reprice, deadman) - no state waits on an event that may never come. Partial/full fills never refund.

governor._doc: runaway brake - a circuit-breaker BOUND, not an estimator (same class as SZ-046's '4 consecutive'). tuition_daily_frac_max: 10 bps of ledger equity/day of realized CLIPPED probe losses; >=2x headroom above the worst-case default spend and ~5x below the pre-fix 2026-07-23 bleed rate the old cap was built for. outlier_clip_div = 24/drought_floor.drought_hours (the system's guaranteed floor pace, config_guard WARNs off it): no SINGLE probe close may contribute more than cap/3 - one probe is never evidence (small-n law); three of the worst class is a regression. Factor = 1 while X <= cap, else clip(cap/X, floor_frac, 1) scaling the REFILL rate - floored, unlatched, self-redeeming as the trailing 86400 s window rolls (SZ-053 on the 1.0-crossing transitions only). The window is the daily budget's own unit - deliberately NOT a knob.

surcharge._doc: Wilson-UPPER win-rate surcharge - ships DARK (spec 1.6; the ONE permitted win-rate term). Stage 0 computes NO surcharge (flat 1.0): the flip is gated on (a) the era-filtered asset_live_outcomes(min_ts) accessor existing with era_min_ts set to the PT-060 deploy epoch (config_guard FATALs enabled-while-null), and (b) scarcity-only having been raced and beaten out-of-sample on the simplicity ladder (OF-4 discipline). wilson_z = 1.96 is the standard 95% bound - mandated by the small-n stats law, never tuned; max_surcharge may at most double a price, and the combined price is clamped at C in code regardless, so no setting can create an unaffordable arm; base_window_labels null = reuse corpus_decay.corpus_target_live (the base is measured over the corpus target's own scale).

admission._budget_doc: SPB-R: Scarcity-Priced Probe Budget, Refunded (2026-07-30 design panel; LANDED DARK - mode stays 'share_cap' until the operator flips it). Replaces the share cap's admission-count denominator - frozen by zero conviction flow (~1 probe/8h measured; 1,517 SZ-047 denials/12h) - with a token bucket refilled in ENGINE time: refill R = tokens_per_day/86400 x governor_factor, capacity C = tokens_per_day x burst_hours/24. Structurally livelock-free: refill is monotone in engine time, no admission-count denominator exists anywhere, p > 0 whenever tokens > 0, every factor is floored (S >= floor, governor >= floor, price <= C), refunds only ADD tokens, and SZ-048 is retained as an independent backstop + alert-wired canary (it should never fire in budget mode). Deduction at placement bounds debt at -C (deduction only from tokens > 0 with cost <= C). Failure direction is always FEWER probes, never more money; dry-run invariant untouched. State {tokens, tuition} is snapshot-persisted; last_refill_ts is NOT (re-seeds to the first engine now after restart, so downtime never accrues tokens - the conservative direction).

exploration._regime_floor_live_doc: Task 4 (#103) regime-coverage hold: corpus_target_live (300) / 5 regime classes = 60 per-regime target. The corpus decay above pools ALL regimes into one live-label count, but a diagnostic found 227/234 live-labeled rows in a SINGLE regime (range) with bear at 4 - probe value is regime-local, and a mature GLOBAL corpus says nothing about an under-covered regime. While the CURRENT macro regime's own live-labeled count sits below regime_floor_live, the decay term is held at 1.0 (no decay, base epsilon) for that regime's signals; at/above the floor the decay above applies unchanged. max_probe_share is NOT touched - it still bounds total probe flow regardless of regime (the stall-under-drought behavior stays deliberate). 0 disables the term (byte-identical P3 behavior). config_guard enforces: FATAL outside [0, corpus_target_live]; WARN if regime_floor_live x 5 > until_live_rows x floor_frac (the term would still dominate the decay it modifies even once every regime is equally represented at graduation).
exploration._probe_throttle_doc: P3 (2026-07-23 P&L diagnosis): probes were 69% of live closes and accounted for -$22.87 of -$31.68 measured net PnL - marginal probe value has fallen while its cost has not. TWO throttles, both bounding toward a floor/cap rather than to zero (the learner keeps a trickle): (a) rolling SHARE CAP - probes may not exceed max_probe_share of the last probe_share_window entry ADMISSIONS (probes+conviction, counted by admission order, never wall-clock; main.py._probe_share_would_deny); (b) CORPUS DECAY - effective_rate = base epsilon x clip(corpus_target_live / max(live_labels, 1), floor_frac, 1.0), folded into the same epsilon roll _exploration_active already gates on (corpus measured 3.3k rows / 214 live 2026-07-23), with a per-regime coverage hold on top (see _regime_floor_live_doc). Denials emit Code.SZ_PROBE_THROTTLED (SZ-047); conviction entries are NEVER throttled by this lever. config_guard enforces: max_probe_share FATAL outside (0, 1]; probe_share_window FATAL outside [10, 500]; corpus_decay.floor_frac FATAL outside (0, 1]; corpus_decay.corpus_target_live WARN coherence if below ml.monitor.deploy_min_oof.

monitor._drift_doc: input-drift (ML-031/032) via decile-PSI vs the model's stored training deciles. drift_min_rows=100: a 10-bin PSI needs ~10 samples/bin; a 40-row window fabricated 19% mean / 28% p95 drift from an IN-DISTRIBUTION sample (null-tested), nearly firing the 30% retrain vote on pure noise — 100 rows drops that floor below 5%. Clock/counter features (hour_sin/cos, funding_dist, regime_age) are excluded from the vote in code (ml.features.DRIFT_EXCLUDED_FEATURES): their PSI reads window phase, not market state. drift_frac_features=0.30: retrain only when >=30% of the MARKET features shift beyond drift_psi_threshold=0.25.
monitor._deescalate_doc: W2-17: de-escalation (any downward level step, e.g. L1->L0) requires this many CONSECUTIVE healthy evaluations before the governor drops a level; escalation stays immediate (fail toward caution). Without this, a Brier hovering within noise of baseline+brier_margin flipped degraded on/off from pure sliding-window churn, toggling kelly_mult (1.0<->0.7) and shrinkage every other trade.
monitor._shadow_recovery_doc: ML-075: while the governor has KILLED the model, score the champion in the background (telemetry-only, never traded) and re-arm one throttled step (level 2->1) when it WOULD have beaten baseline on the trades that actually happened, judged on the identical bar as the kill. Full trust (1->0) is still earned live on model-scored trades. Breaks the kill-recovery deadlock (a killed model records model_scored=False, so the recovery window could never refill and only a retrained challenger could re-arm - a long stall on a young corpus). false restores the old kill lock.

postmortem._doc_stop_gap: stop_gap_factor: a stopped-out trade whose realized loss exceeds this multiple of its configured stop distance is attributed to 'stop_gap' (exit engine could not act - runner outage/observation gap) instead of cost_overrun/alpha_wrong, so ops failures never feed the cost or whipsaw governors. Lived 2026-07-14: 1.8% stop filled at -6.9%.

ml._max_open_candidates_doc: Candidate-labeler pool capacity - a Little's-law queue: required slots = offered registrations/h x slot residence, and with multi_horizon shadows enabled EVERY candidate holds its slot for the FULL label horizon (ml/history.py poll() retains early-labeled candidates until the shadow path completes), so residence = label_max_bars x 5m = 36h. 200 was the 8h-era size and was never resized at the 2026-08-01 24->432 migration: measured 2026-08-16 on outputs/signal_history.csv (era triple_barrier_h432, signal_ts 2026-08-09T01:00Z..2026-08-16T16:40Z, 467 rows, candidate-id seq arithmetic), offered arrivals averaged 5.5-9.3/h by two routes (200 sat AT mean demand, zero headroom) with a PEAK of 659 registrations inside one 36h window (2026-08-13T04:45Z..08-14T16:45Z, exact) - 3.3x the cap - and on fully-resolved launch spans 84% of registrations produced no labeled row (evictions + restart re-mints + stale-feed drops; the eviction pops the NEWEST pending, so busy-hour signals are exactly the ones refused). 1200 = 1.8x the observed peak-36h demand. Guarded in core/config_guard.py: FATAL below ceil(18.3/h x horizon) while shadows retain, WARN with shadows off; bounds [8, 10000] (every pending candidate persists ~KBs into each state.json snapshot). Re-derive the rates from candidate-id seq spans in signal_history.csv before resizing - do NOT shorten label_max_bars to satisfy the guard.

sample_weights._manip_doc: training-hygiene: rows labeled under manipulation-suspect data (manip_suspect feature: spoof/whiplash/cross-venue book divergence, parameter-free max) are down-weighted by (1 - manip_discount * suspect). A painted book teaches the painter's lesson.
sample_weights._uniqueness_doc: AFML ch.4 average-uniqueness correction (Lopez de Prado): overlapping labels on the same asset share the same return path and are NOT independent evidence, so each row's weight is scaled by mean(1/concurrency) over its [signal_ts, ts] lifespan on a uniqueness_grid_sec bar grid. 197 overlapping quiet-weekend candidates stop counting as 197 independent facts. uniqueness_floor bounds the discount so a dense cluster is down-weighted, never erased. Not a fitted knob: grid = the 5-min signal cadence; floor = an order-of-magnitude retention bound.
sample_weights._tb_zero_doc: a candidate zero from the VERTICAL barrier (barrier=='time': price touched neither profit nor stop inside the horizon) is 'no move', weaker evidence against the signal than a realized stop-out; it takes this weight. 1.0 = no distinction (legacy rows with barrier unknown always get full weight). Wu et al. 2020 (Entropy 22:1162): pooling no-touch expiries with directional losses mislabels trend structure.
sample_weights._prior_skew_doc: ML-074 one-sided-batch DETECTOR: if the trailing window_h of labels has a class prior deviating from the corpus prior by more than the threshold (the all-zero quiet-weekend batch), log + flag it in last_load_stats so calibration drift is visible. Detection only - never silently reweights.

interpret._doc: Post-hoc interpretability (scripts/interpret_report.py, ml/interpret.py). REPORT-ONLY analysis knobs, not decision-path tunables: background_rows = history-spanning rows stashed in the model artifact for exact interventional SHAP; corr_cluster_thr = |pearson| union threshold for clustered (Hooker/de-Prado) permutation importance; eval_frac + purge_rows = time-ordered held-out tail; n_repeats = permutation repeats; profile_rows = rows in the attribution fingerprint; drift_cos_warn = fingerprint-rotation cosine below which the report flags attribution drift.

adaptive_gbt._doc: OPT-IN top ladder rung (ml/models.py AdaptiveGBT): bagged, warm-updatable boosted trees. Ships DISABLED - like every new learner it enters the DEPLOYED walk-forward selection only when enabled=true, and even then must beat mlp out-of-sample by the Brier margin to ship (the ladder is evidence-gated). Two upgrades over the single gbt rung, both free of any FITTED degree of freedom: (1) bags decorrelated boosted-stump models on different seeds and probability-averages them (pure variance reduction, exactly what ensemble_seeds does for the MLP); (2) warm_update() appends up to warm_rounds boosting rounds per member on freshly labeled rows between full retrains - continuous learning that leans recent by construction, hard-capped at max_total_trees so it can never grow unbounded. Enabling it changes the deployed selection rule: re-run scripts/overfit_check.py to re-baseline (OF-3 PBO reads this flag), and note the champion/challenger Brier gate is then the only thing between an adaptive_gbt champion and the live paper runner.

gbt_mono._gbt_mono_doc: OPT-IN ladder rung (ml/models.py GradientBoostedStumps monotone_constraints): bound-propagated sign constraints on 5 features whose a priori economic sign is known, so the tree cannot learn a spurious wrong-sign pattern from noise (a model that learns 'wider spread => better fill odds' has learned noise, not signal). +1 = predicted P(win) must be non-decreasing in the feature; -1 = non-increasing. gate_confidence (+1, the pretrade gate's own confidence should never anti-correlate with the label it screens for), spread_bps (-1, wider spread is worse execution cost, never better), fv_edge_bps (+1, larger fair-value edge is the entry thesis itself), flow_tox (-1, VPIN-lite order-flow toxicity is adverse-selection risk), manip_suspect (-1, adversarial-data suspicion can only hurt, never help, a fill's honesty). SHIPPED DISABLED: entering the deployed selection ladder or OF-3's measured PBO space is a CONSCIOUS re-baseline (T3.5 rule), reserved for Task 6 adjudication or later - this task only makes the rung available. Guard (core/config_guard.py): FATAL on a constraint feature name absent from FEATURE_NAMES (lazy-imported at guard time) or a sign outside {1,-1}; WARN above 12 constraints (sign confidence degrades past a handful of genuinely a priori knowable directions).

model_selection._doc: EVIDENCE GATE on the walk-forward selection ladder (ml/walkforward.admissible_families). Model capacity needs a minimum sample-per-effective-parameter to generalize instead of memorize (events-per-variable floor, Peduzzi 1996); a boosted-tree / MLP / bagged ensemble fit on a handful of real outcomes can only overfit, and entering it into selection just manufactures a lucky winner (inflating PBO). So a higher-capacity family is TRAINED and entered into selection only when BOTH floors clear: min_live_rows (real closed-trade labels - complexity is earned on ground truth, not triple-barrier proxies) AND min_total_rows (enough labeled rows to fit non-degenerate purged folds). logistic (the linear baseline) is always admissible and defines the simplicity floor. Floors escalate with capacity; they are order-of-magnitude sample-size floors, NOT tuned to any backtest peak. overfit_check mirrors this gate so OF-3 PBO measures the space the bot actually selects from. enabled=false -> no gating (historical behavior).

overfit._dsr_n_trials_doc: OF-5 deflated-Sharpe trials count (Bailey-Lopez de Prado 2014 E[max] deflation; Harvey-Liu-Zhu RFS 2016 multiple-testing honesty). LIFTED literal (2026-07-30 Debate-1 item A) with the IDENTICAL default the gate always ran - behavior-preserving. Semantics: the number of strategy/model trials the observed max Sharpe was selected over; RAISING it deflates harder (conservative), LOWERING it below the shipped 7 weakens the gate (config_guard WARNs). The full lifetime trials LEDGER that should back this number is deferred behind a written increment policy (Debate-1 A amendment) - until then, change this value only with a recorded rationale in docs/quant/.

ml._telemetry_doc: T2.2 report-only sim-to-live instruments (learnaccel Phase 2). lineage_min_pairs: minimum dedup-twin pairs before the ML-077 agreement log line fires (the stat itself always computes into last_load_stats). divergence_window_h: bucket width for the ML-078 live-covered-window divergence score (Task 4). era_mix_drift_window_h/_min_rows/_tvd_threshold: the ML-080 barrier/exit-reason mix-drift alarm (label-era instrumentation, DEEP DIVE progress.md) - recent-window vs trailing-corpus exit-reason mix via total-variation distance; min_rows gates the alarm SILENT (not a spurious warning) when the recent window is too thin to trust; threshold is the TVD past which last_load_stats['era_mix_drift']['fired'] flips true and ML-080 logs. bracket_divergence_tolerance_pct/_window_n: the ML-082 labeled-vs-realized bracket comparator (geometry-alignment T6, spec D6) - percentage-point tolerance between a bracket close's realized net return and its own stamped-geometry counterfactual before it counts 'disagree', and the rolling close-count window ml/history.py's bracket_divergence_summary() reports over. Report-only: never read by any decision path, never gates training/retrain/entry/exit/size, never touches a label/weight/row.
ml._linkage_doc: T2.4 Fellegi-Sunter EM record linkage (ported from fast-er, MIT, Morrier/Kishore/Alvarez 2024; seeded + print-free). Report-only: scripts/corpus_linkage_report.py links live closes to candidate twins beyond exact lineage keys and expands the T2.2b agreement sample. posterior_threshold: minimum P(match|pattern) to count a pair as linked - [0.5, 0.999] guarded; below 0.5 would link majority-non-match patterns. seed: EM init determinism. Feeds NO weights - density-ratio consumption is Phase 4, own gates.
ml._epoch_doc: T3.6a config-derivation-boundary marker (commit 95501ed, 2026-07-23T18:20:55Z = epoch seconds 1784830855): rows whose triple-barrier/candidate label RESOLVED before this instant were priced under a materially different config era (label geometry, weighting, gates) than what ships today. Two consumers share this one cutoff: (1) report-only - scripts/overfit_check.py's --epoch-ab experiment arm builds a TRAINING-side row mask (candidate rows resolved before cutoff excluded; ALL live rows always kept) for an opt-in A/B measured inside OF-3's PBO space (ml.overfit.model_space_pbo); (2) the production loader seam (T3.6, ml/history.py load_training_data's epoch_cfg) - exclude_old_candidates gates the SAME cutoff as a real training-corpus filter, SHIPPED FALSE: the production flip, if the Task 6 experiment verdict ever justifies it, is its own conscious commit, never a side effect of this default. Neither consumer ever excludes a live row - guarded structurally in the loader (the check only ever runs inside the source=="candidate" branch) and by construction in the mask builder. Guard (core/config_guard.py): FATAL if candidate_cutoff_ts is not a number or outside [1752000000, 1900000000]; FATAL if exclude_old_candidates is true while candidate_cutoff_ts is missing/invalid. See ml.era_exclusion below for a DIFFERENT, era-based production filter (docs/quant/2026-07-26_era_exclusion.md) - orthogonal to this one, both may be active.
ml._era_exclusion_doc: Era-gated training exclusion (operator decision, 2026-07-26, docs/quant/2026-07-26_era_exclusion.md): threshold-armed, reversible LOAD-TIME view over ml/history.py load_training_data. Measured corpus at decision time: 4,897 rows, 100% old-era (exit_sim 2481+195, legacy 1734+47, exit_sim_time_stop 440 across candidate+live) - the training label was just redefined (commit d5a9859) so the label measures signal quality, not the exit policy those rows were labeled under. Two operator decisions, both consciously override earlier defaults and must not be softened: (1) exclusion covers LIVE rows too - overrides ml.epoch's 'live rows never' term, because all 242 measured live rows are themselves old-era and keeping them would shrink the corpus without cleaning it; (2) ships gated and inert (0 new-era rows exist today) and auto-activates once enough new-era (LABEL_ERA_TRIPLE_BARRIER, ml/history.py label_era_of) rows exist to be worth training on - never a manual flip. min_new_era_rows=150: NOT an invented round figure - it equals ml.min_train_rows (ml/meta_model.py, scripts/train_meta.py: the floor before ANY model trains) and ml.model_selection.min_total_rows['gbt'/'blend'] (the evidence-gate floor for the first non-trivial rung above logistic, the always-admissible simplicity floor); training on the new-era subset alone needs to clear the SAME floor the corpus already has to clear to train anything at all. forced_off: the rollback lever - forces the filter OFF regardless of the threshold; flipping it (+ restart) restores the pre-exclusion training set exactly, because exclusion is a load-time VIEW only and no row is ever removed from outputs/signal_history.csv. forced_on: manual override lever, SHIPPED false - the threshold arms this feature, an operator does not flip it on (config_guard FATALs forced_on while ml.label_mode isn't 'triple_barrier': the era this filter selects for could then never be produced, and a forced-on filter would train on zero rows forever). Era-based (label_era_of), never a clock - a different mechanism from ml.epoch above; both may be active (epoch's candidate_cutoff_ts predates every triple_barrier row that can exist today, so with both on the composed corpus is identical to era-exclusion alone). Wired to every corpus consumer that trains or measures the deployed selection rule (main.py, scripts/overfit_check.py, scripts/train_meta.py, scripts/interpret_report.py, scripts/feature_stability.py); scripts/smoke_test.py's synthetic single-row candidate fixture is consciously EXEMPTED (no config.json in scope, structurally cannot reach any sane threshold) - see docs/quant/2026-07-26_era_exclusion.md and docs/quant/pbo_admission_policy.md.

bracket_exits._doc: Spec D1 (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-27-geometry-alignment-design.md, geometry-alignment Task 5): 'the traded bet is the labeled bet'. Every model-lane entry (conviction AND probe alike - operator decision 1) computes its own triple-barrier bracket (pt_frac/sl_frac) at fill time from ml/labeling.py's barrier_geometry() - the SAME pure helper ml.label_pt_cost_mult's cost-floored geometry already drives for the candidate labeler (Task 2) - using this entry's own sigma_bar and the pretrade decision's own est_cost_bps, and stamps it on the Position (core/state.py bracket_pt_frac/bracket_sl_frac/bracket_deadline_ts). Exit evaluation for a bracket position REPLACES the tier engine's scheduled profit-take for that position (never both). 2026-07-29 wedge correction (live incident, LINK 3ea2a851): the PT-060 time-stop is NOT suppressed - it is a protective overlay (P2 derivation: no-progress cohort MFE 0.16%/MAE -1.44%, recovered 0/17) and stays senior like the give-back ratchet; suppressing it left a no-progress probe wedged between the 36-bar scratch and the 96-bar deadline and it bled -1.69% where the scratch takes ~-0.2%. pt leg fires a maker-first profit exit at entry*(1+/-pt_frac); sl leg reuses the existing protective-stop escalation ladder at entry*(1-/+sl_frac); past bracket_deadline_ts (entry + ml.label_max_bars bars) the remainder closes via the normal exit ladder, reason 'tb_time'. Overlays (give-back/chandelier ratchet, hard-stop drawdown flatten, force_dry, manip gate, watchdog) stay senior and keep firing/their own reasons - exits are ALWAYS allowed (CLAUDE.md invariant 5). Close reasons tb_pt/tb_sl/tb_time thread VERBATIM into the live-label row's barrier column (ml/history.py HistoryStore.log_close), joining LABEL_ERA_TRIPLE_BARRIER natively (V1's closure - previously every live close hardcoded 'realized', landing in the exit_sim era instead). false is the escape hatch: every model-lane position reverts to the legacy tier engine, byte-identical to pre-T5 (CLAUDE.md invariant 7). Guarded FATAL in core/config_guard.py against enabled=true while ml.label_mode != 'triple_barrier' (the bracket trades the tb bet; incoherent otherwise).

sentiment.description: Free multi-source sentiment (Google News RSS per figure, crypto news RSS, Hacker News crowd via Algolia public API). FILTER ONLY - shades risk/confidence within clamps, never triggers trades. No API keys.
sentiment.figure_keywords: bitcoin OR crypto OR ethereum OR markets

system._lock_progress_doc: C1b (2026-08-01): how long the main loop may go without advancing before the lock-heartbeat thread STOPS claiming outputs/runner.lock. C1 moved the heartbeat off the cycle thread so a slow cycle could not age the lock past its 30s stale window - correct, and it fixed the false takeovers behind both audit-chain forks (RT-010 x2, both lost_count=3). But an unconditional heartbeat proves only that the PROCESS is alive: a cycle_once that HANGS rather than raises would then hold the lock forever, and no healthy runner could ever replace it. The wedge guard does not cover a hang (runner.py scopes it to a cycle that RAISES every iteration), so before C1 the stale lock WAS the sole recovery path and C1 removed it. This bound restores it: refresh while the loop MOVES however slowly, withhold once it has demonstrably stopped. DERIVED, not tuned: 300s is ~3.4x the worst stall ever measured on this machine (88.1s; the others were 55.5/50.2/48.4/47.8s, outputs/runner.log) and 10x SingleInstanceLock.stale_after_sec (30s) - far above any legitimate cycle, far below an interval an operator would fail to notice. Startup is exempt by construction: the heartbeat thread starts BEFORE the unbounded LiquidityBot build, so _last_progress_ts is None until the first iteration and refresh is unconditional until then. config_guard FATALs outside [60, 3600] and FATALs at/below 2x the lock stale window.
system._cycle_fail_halt_doc: consecutive whole-cycle (cycle_once) failures the runner tolerates before it latches a NEW-RISK halt and fires one loud alert. Exits still run every cycle (invariant #5); the runner never auto-flattens on a wedge (a transient feed outage must not dump the book) nor self-terminates (a deterministic fault would relaunch-storm). At ~5s polling, 10 = ~50s of a wedged loop before halting new entries. Cleared by an operator resume, not by a lucky cycle.

recording._doc: Retention + rotation for recorded feed sessions (data/recording.py). Operational/disk knobs only, not a decision path: max_file_mb rolls one boot's session file to .partNN past the cap; retain_days/retain_files bound how much history is kept (0 disables that arm). Each session also gets a session_*.meta.json flat-start sidecar (start/end realized P&L + equity + open positions) that the replay-vs-live reconciliation gate ties out.

websockets.description: Push-based Binance.US depth stream (data/ws_feed.py), read-only cross-venue depth for BTC/ETH. OFF by default: Binance.US's ws is geo/proxy-blocked from the Anthropic cloud container (Connection reset by peer, endless reconnects, shows 'disconnected'), and the Kraken v2 ws below already delivers the real-time execution-venue books. Enable this ONLY when running on the always-on PC, where Binance.US ws connects and adds sub-second cross-venue depth; REST is the always-on fallback regardless.
websockets.kraken_max_book_age_sec_note: MUST stay strictly below pretrade.max_data_staleness_ms/1000 (4.0s); config_guard FATALs otherwise. At the previous 5.0 the ws cache SERVED books aged 4-5s that the pre-trade gate then vetoed (PT-020) - and because main.py only falls back to REST when the ws returns None, that doomed book PREEMPTED a REST read that would have been fresh, silently refusing entries on the thinnest pairs (~3% of evaluations there). 3.5 leaves headroom for the measured cycle read delay (p50 0.34s, p90 0.68s) and costs ~0.6 extra REST book calls/cycle against a 15/cycle budget. Lower this knob rather than raising the veto ceiling.
websockets.kraken_checksum_backoff_note: W2-28: consecutive checksum-mismatch resubscribe backoff (doubling from base, capped at cap, reset by the next clean verified frame) - paces the RESUBSCRIBE REQUEST only, never data availability. A mismatch still drops local state + invalidates the cache immediately on every occurrence, forcing an instant REST fallback read; only how often we ASK Kraken to resubscribe is bounded, so a systematic (not one-off) desync can't churn reconnects at zero delay.
websockets.kraken_note: Kraken v2 public book channel (wss://ws.kraken.com/v2). Real-time incremental books for the 6 trading_pairs, keyed by Kraken REST pair so fast_cycle's get_order_book(pair) reads the cache and skips the rate-limited REST Depth loop. Read-only public data; Kraken execution stays on the REST order path (invariant 3). Fail-safe: stale/down/disabled -> REST.

webdata.description: Free keyless crypto context: CoinGecko global (BTC dominance, mcap) + alternative.me Fear & Greed index.

thales.description: Lazy-bot insecurity model (docs/THALES.md): detects grid ladders, clock-driven MM quoting, significance-gated scheduled flow, and stop-cluster sweeps from public data. influence=shadow records advice without applying it; advise applies bounded confidence shading only.

evidence_concentration._doc: TH-021 (docs/THALES.md §Evidence concentration): the fused evidence E = Σ wᵢ·sᵢ is a weighted SUM, so a DIFFUSE signal (many weak factors averaged) can clear the same |E| bar as a PINPOINTED one. This shade trims a signal's confidence toward the floor ONLY when it is BOTH diffuse (concentration < conc_pivot) AND marginal (confidence between floor_conf and marginal_conf); concentrated conviction or an already-strong signal is untouched. Down-only, bounded to [1-max_atten, 1.0]. enabled=false keeps EXACT prior behavior — flip true only after shadow hit-rate beats null and the OF/quant battery stays green (the doc's promotion bar).

reliability._doc: V2 evidence-weighted gains: every closed advise-mode trade grades the detectors that shaded its entry (up-advice vindicated by a win, down-advice by a loss). Below min_fired grades a detector keeps its full configured gain (the hand-crafted prior rules cold start); after that the gain is scaled by max(0, 2*WilsonLCB90 - 1), so a detector that cannot beat a coin flip out-of-sample loses its voice. Weights ATTENUATE only, never amplify. feed_integrity is exempt (safety shade, not an alpha thesis).

spoof._doc: TH-017 spoof/layering flicker (Cartea-Jaimungal-Wang: spoofing operates through top-of-book imbalance; its snapshot footprint is a level >= big_ratio x median top depth that vanishes >= drop_frac while the mid never crossed it - pulled, not consumed). Per-side EWMA (decay per fast snapshot); entries whose direction the flickering side baits are shaded down past score_thr. SAFETY shade: exempt from V2 reliability grading.

barclose._doc: TH-015: no-code/indicator bots evaluate on candle close; their activity clusters in the first seconds after bar boundaries (intraday periodicity). Buckets top-of-book change events by phase-of-bar; score = excess share of bucket zero.

feed_integrity._doc: TH-014: shade an asset's entry confidence DOWN when its book feed shows a sustained rate of missing/sanitize-rejected data (hostile or unreliable venue). Softer, per-asset complement to the watchdog's hard staleness block. window=recent fast cycles tracked; min_obs before it judges; dirty_frac_thr=rejection fraction above which shading engages; gain=shade strength.

lapse._doc: TH-016: observation-lapse hygiene, distilled from the 2026-07-14 incident (container restart + proxy outages: hours-long gaps in our own observation stream were treated as continuous, and advice ran on stale evidence at full confidence). fast_gap_sec=gap between clean book observations above which continuity state resets and advice mutes; warmup_sec=mute duration while the detector bank re-warms; bar_gap_bars=candle hole (in units of observed bar spacing) that fences swing/sweep context; clock_skew_tol_sec=backwards-clock tolerance before a time regression counts as a lapse.

smc.description: Smart Money Concepts structural features (docs/SMC.md): multi-timeframe trend alignment, premium/discount zone, liquidity-pocket pull, fair-value-gap pull + confluence, volume-profile POC/Value-Area position. Pure feature computation added to the meta-model's feature vector - never a gate, never a veto, never sizes or times an order.

circuit_breaker._doc: per-asset consecutive-loss circuit breaker: after loss_streak FULL-trade losses in a row on one asset, NEW entries on that asset are vetoed (SZ-046) for cooldown_hours, then it auto-resets (a win resets the streak any time). Early, local protection the portfolio-level budgets react to late; exits are never touched (invariant 5).

skimmer._doc: asset skimmer: scan a candidate pool beyond the core trading_pairs, rank tradability (spread cost / book depth / bar activity), and PROMOTE the best into the active universe at the NEXT RESTART (runner.main merges outputs/skimmer_active.json into trading_pairs on the live path only - replay/overfit stay pinned to the recorded universe). Core pairs are permanent; at most max_extra promotions, keeping the worst-case REST-fallback budget (3 req/s with WS down) inside the ~12-pair envelope. Watching costs <=2 REST calls per evaluation, one candidate round-robin per loop pass, each at most once per eval_every_min. Promoted assets face every existing rail (EV gate, sizer, protocols, heat, firewall, manip gate); demotion only removes them from the NEXT boot - open positions keep their exits. apply_in_live=false means promotions apply in dry-run only until explicitly enabled for live.
skimmer._max_extra_doc: 6 -> 5 on 2026-08-05 when PAXG joined the core pairs. The REST-fallback envelope is a real capacity limit, not a preference: with the WS feed down the book poll runs at 3 req/s, and base(7) + extra(6) = 13 pairs would starve it (the config guard fatals on exactly this). Gold therefore costs one DISCRETIONARY skimmer slot - a permanent tangible-value anchor in place of a rotating candidate, which is the trade the operator asked for. Raising this again requires raising the envelope first.

grid_ladder._doc: v10 logistic-armed grid entry ladder (execution/grid_ladder.py). When a confirmed signal's meta p(win) clears p_win_arm, the single sizer-approved entry is split into `rungs` resting maker limits stepped away from the quote: rung 0 AT the pretrade-approved price, deeper rungs spacing_vol_mult x sigma_bar_bps apart (floored at min_spacing_bps), sizes decay-weighted (size_decay^k, normalized) so the LADDER TOTAL EXACTLY EQUALS the sized single-entry units - the risk stack's approval is split, never multiplied. Deeper rungs sit strictly further from fair value than the EV-gated rung-0 price, so the gate's verdict is monotone down the ladder. Hysteresis: armed ladders persist until p(win) < p_win_disarm (must be < p_win_arm) - no flapping at the bar. Retraction on spoofy book / manip veto / direction flip; resting rungs die on the OrderManager's own short timeout, so no rung outlives its thesis. Rung count is capped live by free position slots and the per-asset same-side inventory cap. Knobs are execution-shape (category round numbers, config-lifted, guarded), not fitted alpha: the EV gate still prices every entry. enabled=false is the exact legacy single-entry path.
